title: 俗世凡尘 第3章 南宫修俗世凡尘 第4章 云隐门

“晚辈南宫修，谢前辈救命之恩。”经过邢大夫的妙手回春，那汉子睡了一日，竟然醒了过来，对着阿土伯就要起身下拜。
他重伤初醒，阿土伯哪肯让他下拜，忙扶住他，说道：“壮士多礼了，你伤势还重，还是躺着吧。”
那汉子自知伤重，倒也没再坚持。转头看了看桥洞内的陈设，又看了看阿土伯，惊讶地道：“想不到前辈过得如此清贫。”
阿土伯平静地道：“惭愧，老头子原籍天水，前两年逃难到此，不幸沦为乞丐。这桥洞实在破陋，委屈壮士了。”这桥洞又矮又窄，啥都没，南宫修一个伤者都睡在稻草堆里，实在太过寒碜，也不干净。
南宫修忙道：“前辈多虑了，蒙前辈大恩，晚辈侥幸捡回了一条性命，岂会觉得委屈。只是想不到前辈菩萨心肠，竟遭此大难。两国交兵，竟令百万百姓流离失所，真是可恨，可叹……”
“阿土伯，我回来了。今儿个运气不错，有个好心人赏了三文钱，我买了三个馒头，正好一人一个。”正当两人在说话的时候，陆多福走了进来。
阿土伯道：“嘘，阿福，小点声，这位壮士伤口未愈，别惊着人家。”
陆多福买到三个馒头，正高兴不已，忽想起来桥洞内还躺着人，自觉说话太大声了，于是赶紧捂住了嘴。直到看见已经醒过来的南宫修，又惊喜地道：“啊，原来这位大叔醒了呀！那正好，咱们仨一人一个，趁热吃。”
南宫修赶忙道：“小朋友，请问你叫什么名字？”
阿土伯给南宫修说明了陆多福的来历，南宫修听得陆多福身世如此凄惨，也是摇头叹息。
“大叔，你一定肚子饿了吧。先吃个馒头，等晚些我再出去讨些吃的。”陆多福说罢，将馒头递给了南宫修，给阿土伯拿了一个，剩下一个留给自己。
南宫修啃了一口，也不知道是心情不好，还是这馒头食之无味，只觉得晦涩难咽。他停下来，问阿土伯道：“前辈，你们平日里就吃这个么？”
阿土伯和陆多福昨日本来就每人只吃了一个包子，到现在已经饿得不行，也顾不得南宫修在场，早已狼吞虎咽起来。听得南宫修发问，阿土伯含糊不清地道：“有这个吃都不错了，要是天天有馒头吃，就烧高香了。像我们这样的人，挨饿是常有的事，实在饿极了，只能躺着不动。我老头子一个将死之人，活到这个岁数已经够本了，可是阿福他十岁都还不到，竟要遭此磨难……”
看着陆多福枯瘦如柴的身躯，南宫修心中五味杂陈，陷入久久沉思。
陆多福问道：“大叔，你怎么不吃啊？可是伤口还疼，不会是邢大夫没给你治好吧？我找他去。”
南宫修急忙道：“不用不用，我好着呢，你赶紧歇会吧。”真是个心地善良的好孩子，南宫修心道。
原来这南宫修来自一个叫云隐门的武道门派，这次出来，是为了会见一个老朋友。可是在归途中，他路见不平拔刀相助，惹到了不该惹的人，于是被人家联合暗算。虽然南宫修仗着一身修为，打死打伤几个敌人，但是还是受了重伤，他拖着重伤来到了安阳城，意外被陆多福救了。
“多福小朋友，我问你一句，你是怎么想到带我去茅房躲的？”南宫修想起昨日的事情，越发觉得后怕，转念又想到陆多福带自己去藏身这个举动，尤其是他打翻粪桶的行为，绝对不是无心之举。想到这里，南宫修越发觉得此子不简单，不由得问上一问。
陆多福黑脸微红，说道：“因为这世上的人都怕大粪啊，我用大粪堵着他们，他们就不会进来了。”

没错，这世上所有的人都爱钱，也同样的讨厌大粪，这是陆多福无意中发现的。
人都是排外的，而且天生喜欢欺凌弱小，孩子也不例外。陆多福刚刚跟娘亲逃亡到安阳城的时候，那时钱小胖他们一伙城里的小少爷，看见跟他们年纪相仿，却成天脏兮兮瘦巴巴又可怜的陆多福，就三天两头去欺负他。
有一日，陆多福被他们追打得急了，慌不择路跑进了一条死胡同，随后被钱小胖他们揍了一顿扎实的。
避无可避，逃无可逃之下，陆多福偶然看见地上有一摊牛粪，于是捡起牛粪当武器反打几人。
钱小胖他们一帮少爷哪见过这种打法，当牛粪劈头盖脸砸过来，眼睛鼻子嘴巴全部被稀烂的牛粪糊住的时候，他们顿时不知所措。方才五个嚣张跋扈的孩子当场就被陆多福打哭了三个，剩下的两个落荒而逃，被手抓牛粪的陆多福追了八条街。
从此几个小少爷见到陆多福就感觉脊背发凉，再也不敢去招惹他。不过孩子没有隔夜仇，陆多福也没想把他们怎么样，以至于后来钱小胖甚至还关照起陆多福来了。
而陆多福从这事上发现了粪便的厉害，这些城里的贵人都怕这个。有一回他在一家饭店门口要饭被店里的伙计打了，陆多福一怒之下在夜里偷偷在他们店门口泼满大粪，弄得那家店三天没做成生意。从此店里的伙计再也不敢打他，有时候还会主动把一些剩菜剩饭拿出来孝敬这位小灾星。
“哈哈哈，真有你的。”南宫修听了陆多福的解释，放声笑了起来，随后触动了伤口，又咳嗽了两声。
陆多福急道：“南宫大叔，你没事吧？”
“咳咳……没事，好孩子，也幸亏你如此机灵，否则我这次恐怕在劫难逃，你可救了我一命啊！我可得好好谢谢你啊！”南宫修爱怜地摸了摸陆多福的头，随后陷入沉思。
陆多福怪不好意思的。作为一名臭乞丐，他从来都只有被人嫌弃的份，全城的人除了钱小胖，都对他避之唯恐不及。哪会想到臭乞丐陆多福有一日能救人性命，被南宫修夸赞。
接下来的几日，南宫修就安心在此养伤，陆多福负责照顾他。不过他实在不擅长干这个，好几次都是帮了倒忙。南宫修也不会跟一个孩子计较，相反他倒是挺喜欢这个孩子，闲暇时就陆多福讲一些江湖轶事，听得陆多福心生向往。
南宫修有些钱，这几日陆多福也不必出去乞讨了。三人吃喝都用钱买，陆多福长这么大，还从来没有像现在一样顿顿能吃饱饭，还能吃上肉。几日下来，整个人都精神了些，脸上都有光了。南宫修看了，高兴之余，又有些心疼。
南宫修的伤养了半个月，也就能走动了。疗伤期间找邢大夫看了几次。伤好的七七八八后，南宫修因为门派有急事，辞别了阿土伯和陆多福，给他们留了一些钱财作为报答。
南宫修走后不久，年老体衰的阿土伯因为常年体弱多病，离开了人世。跟娘亲一样，阿土伯临终前，也是叮嘱陆多福要好好活着，只有活着才会有盼头。
陆多福大哭了一场，用南宫修留下的钱财，找了几个人将阿土伯安葬了。就这样，陆多福成为了一个孤独的乞丐，日复一日地乞讨着。
每天夜里，陆多福都是哭累了才能睡着。他很害怕，桥洞破门外寒风呜呜地呼啸着，像鬼在笑。陆多福很想爹娘，也很想念阿土伯，可现在他们都不在了。黯淡人世间，茫茫前程路，只留下形单影只的陆多福一个人，在安阳城里如孤魂野鬼一般苟活着。

"Junior Nangong Xiu, thank you senior for saving your life." After Dr. Xing's wonderful rejuvenation, the man woke up after sleeping for a day, and stood up to bow to Atubo.
When he first woke up after being seriously injured, Atub was not willing to let him bow down. He quickly supported him and said, "You are so polite, strong man. You are still seriously injured, so you should lie down."
The man knew he was seriously injured, but he didn't hold on any longer. He turned around and looked at the furnishings in the bridge cave, then looked at Atubo, and said in surprise: "I didn't expect that my senior lived in such poverty."
Atubo said calmly: "I'm ashamed. The old man was originally from Tianshui. He fled here two years ago and unfortunately became a beggar. This bridge is really shabby and it has wronged the brave men." This bridge is short and narrow and has nothing. Nangong Xiu and the injured sleep in the straw pile. It is too shabby and unclean.
Nangong Xiu hurriedly said: "Senior, you are too worried. Thanks to my great kindness, I am lucky enough to save a life. How can I feel aggrieved? I just didn't expect that my senior Bodhisattva's heart would lead to such a disaster. The war between the two countries has displaced millions of people. It is really hateful and lamentable..."
"A Tubo, I'm back. I was lucky today. A kind man rewarded me with three cents. I bought three steamed buns, just one for each person." While the two were talking, Lu Duofu walked in.
Atupo said: "Shh, Ahfu, keep your voice down, this strong man's wound has not healed, so don't scare others."
Lu Duofu bought three steamed buns and was very happy when he suddenly remembered that there was someone lying in the bridge hole. He felt that he was speaking too loudly, so he quickly covered his mouth. Until he saw Nangong Xiu who had woken up, he said in surprise: "Ah, it turns out this uncle is awake! That's just right, let's eat it while it's hot."
Nangong Xiu hurriedly said: "Kid, what is your name?"
Atubo explained Lu Duofu's origins to Nangong Xiu. Nangong Xiu shook his head and sighed when he heard that Lu Duofu's life experience was so miserable.
"Uncle, you must be hungry. Eat a steamed bun first, and I will go out to beg for some food later." After Lu Duofu said that, he handed the steamed bun to Nangong Xiu, took one for Atubo, and kept the remaining one for himself.
Nangong Xiu took a bite. He didn't know whether it was because he was in a bad mood or because the steamed bun was tasteless. He just felt it was obscure and difficult to swallow. He stopped and asked Atubo: "Senior, do you eat this on weekdays?"
A Tubo and Lu Duofu each only ate one bun yesterday. By now they were so hungry that they had already devoured it without caring about Nangong Xiu's presence. Hearing Nangong Xiu's question, Atubo said vaguely: "It's good to eat with this. If you have steamed buns to eat every day, it will be very incense. For people like us, starvation is a common thing. We are really hungry and can only lie still. My old man is a dying man. It is enough to live to this age, but Ah Fu is not even ten years old yet, and he has to suffer this..."
Looking at Lu Duofu's skinny body, Nangong Xiu felt mixed emotions and fell into deep thought for a long time.
Lu Duofu asked: "Uncle, why don't you eat? But the wound still hurts. Could it be that Doctor Xing didn't cure you? I'll go find him."
Nangong Xiu said hurriedly: "No, no, I'm fine. You should take a break." He is really a good boy with a kind heart, Nangong Xiu said.
It turns out that Nangong Xiu comes from a martial arts sect called Yunyin Sect. He came out this time to meet an old friend. However, on the way back, he drew his sword to help when he saw an injustice, and offended someone he shouldn't have, so he was plotted by others together. Although Nangong Xiu relied on his cultivation to kill and wound several enemies, he was still seriously injured. He dragged his serious injuries to Anyang City and was accidentally rescued by Lu Duofu.
"Kid Duofu, let me ask you, how did you think of taking me to hide in the hut?" Nangong Xiu thought of what happened yesterday and felt more and more scared. Then he thought of Lu Duofu's move of taking him to hide, especially since heThe act of knocking over the dung bucket was definitely not an unintentional act. Thinking of this, Nangong Xiu felt more and more that this boy was not simple, so he couldn't help but ask.
Lu Duofu's face was dark and slightly red, and he said, "Because people in this world are afraid of feces. If I block them with feces, they won't come in."
Yes, everyone in this world loves money, but they also hate poop. This is what Lu Duofu discovered accidentally.
People are xenophobic and naturally like to bully the weak, and children are no exception. When Lu Duofu and his mother fled to Anyang City, Qian Xiaopang and a group of young men in the city saw Lu Duofu, who was about the same age as them but was dirty, skinny and pitiful all day long, so they bullied him every day.
One day, Lu Duofu was chased by them in a hurry and ran into a dead end in a panic. Later, he was beaten hard by Qian Xiaopang and the others.
With no way to escape or escape, Lu Duofu accidentally saw a puddle of cow dung on the ground, so he picked up the cow dung and used it as a weapon to beat several people.
Qian Xiaopang and the other young men had never seen this type of fighting before. When the cow dung hit their heads and faces, and their eyes, nose, and mouth were completely covered in the pulpy cow dung, they were at a loss. Three of the five arrogant and domineering children were beaten to tears by Lu Duofu on the spot. The remaining two fled and were chased eight streets by Lu Duofu, who was holding cow dung.
From then on, the young masters felt chills running down their spines when they saw Lu Duofu, and they never dared to provoke him again. However, the children did not have an overnight feud, and Lu Duofu did not want to do anything to them, so that Qian Xiaopang even took care of Lu Duofu later.
And Lu Duofu discovered the power of feces from this incident, and the nobles in the city were afraid of this. Once, when he was begging for food in front of a restaurant, the waiter beat him up. In anger, Lu Duofu secretly poured feces in front of their store at night, causing no business in the store for three days. From then on, the waiters in the store no longer dared to beat him, and sometimes took the initiative to take out some leftovers to honor this little disaster star.
"Hahaha, it's really yours." After hearing Lu Duofu's explanation, Nangong Xiu laughed loudly, then touched the wound and coughed twice.
Lu Duofu said anxiously: "Uncle Nangong, are you okay?"
"Ahem...it's okay, good boy. Fortunately, you are so smart. Otherwise, I might have been doomed this time. You saved my life! I have to thank you very much!" Nangong Xiu touched Lu Duofu's head lovingly, and then fell into deep thought.
Lu Duofu felt embarrassed. As a stinky beggar, he has always been disliked by others. Everyone in the city, except Qian Xiaopang, avoids him. Who would have thought that the stinky beggar Lu Duofu could one day save people's lives and be praised by Nangong Xiu.
In the next few days, Nangong Xiu rested here to recover from his injuries, and Lu Duofu was responsible for taking care of him. However, he is really not good at doing this, and it has been a disservice several times. Nangong Xiu would not argue with a child. On the contrary, he liked the child very much. In his spare time, he told Lu Duofu some anecdotes about the world, which made Lu Duofu yearn for him.
Nangong Xiu has some money, and Lu Duofu doesn't have to go out begging these days. The three of them spent money to buy food and drink. Lu Duofu has never been able to eat as much as he does now, and he can also eat meat. After a few days, I became more energetic and my face became brighter. Nangong Xiu looked at it, feeling happy but also a little distressed.
Nangong Xiu recovered from his injury for half a month and was able to walk around. During the healing period, I saw Dr. Xing several times. After recovering from his injuries, Nangong Xiu said goodbye to Atubo and Lu Duofu because of an urgent matter in the sect, and left them some money in return.
Not long after Nangong Xiu left, the old and frail Atubo passed away due to years of frailty and illness. Just like his mother, before his death, Atubo also told Lu Duofu to live well, as only by living can he have hope.
Lu Duofu cried loudly and used the words left by Nangong Xiu toWith money, they found a few people to bury Atubo. In this way, Lu Duofu became a lonely beggar, begging day after day.
Every night, Lu Duofu couldn't fall asleep until he was tired from crying. He was very scared. The cold wind whistled outside the broken door of the bridge, like a ghost laughing. Lu Duofu misses his parents very much, and also misses Atubo, but now they are both gone. In the bleak world and the vast road ahead, only Lu Duofu is left alone, living like a lonely ghost in Anyang City.
